test_title: PYST 29: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: If L + M means that L is the father of M, L × M means that L is the mother of M, L – M means that L is the brother of M then which of the following expression shows that A is the paternal uncle of B?
solution:
**Given:**

 
 

 **Code**
 **Meaning**
 
 

 L + M
 L is the father of M
 
 

 L × M
 L is the mother of M
 
 

 L – M
 L is the brother of M
 
 

A is the paternal uncle of B

Firstly, Draw family tree for each option,

**Option 1 : **A – C + B

A – C means that A is the brother of C

C + B means that C is the father of B

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e8f8fbfc0682ffa07c129766366430c98029150224a27dd079d56deade2e86e.png] 

Here, A is the paternal uncle of B. So it will be the answer.

Option 2 : A – B + C

A – B means that A is the brother of B

B + C means that B is the father of C

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd57de681749d08856ed30e9df6581fff1bfee411fb18658e0591ce5cd1ef0b4.png] 

Option 3 : A + B – C

A + B means that A is the father of B

B – C means that B is the brother of C

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00ef23e4e6f3afb444415a6755b462d830a960300e0233e6a5561a884526e185.png] 

Option 4 : A – B × C

A – B means that A is the brother of B

B × C means that B is the mother of C

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d19219f209e604e826f752c37a10288afcda5d2432ed97e12fa4200880b27952.png] 

Hence, **'Option 1'** is the correct answer.
